name: Marian
source:
Liera's personal maid. Liera doesn't let anyone take care of her besides Marian. Her experience and maturity is beyond her years.

[spoiler] She is actually Boudicca, the former reigning Queen of Dius who transported her soul into the body of her maid when Irell destroyed her kingdom. And thus is Liera's mother. [/spoiler]
